topic: Lidar video analysis and data requirements
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on analyzing lidar footage, specifically noting that the cars appear in the top right corner of the video. It was noted that levels were not used when placing the lidar unit, and a long line visible is identified as the floor.

Frequency details were discussed; the data capture rate is estimated to be around 4-5Hz, though one participant suggested the video may appear slow. Examples of passing cars were provided with specific timestamps (e.g., 17:03, 15:27).

At the end of the session, a request was made for data upload.
decisions: The lidar footage analysis confirmed that levels were not used during setup.
action_items: Upload the necessary data files and video to facilitate further analysis.
